S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  WPCRL No.602 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Manisha Bhandari, learned counsel and Ms. Prabha Naithani, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. J.S. Virk, learned D.A.G. with Mr. R.K. Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.

3. Petitioner faced trial for offence punishable under Sections 354A, 376(2), 323, 504 IPC; Section 5/6 and Section 21(2) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Section 67A of the Information Technology Act and was convicted vide judgment dated 16.10.2018 passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO), Almora in Special Sessions Trial No.23 of 2018 and was sentenced to life.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The Special Judge (POCSO) also observed in the judgment that Superintendent of Jail and Jailor concerned shall not give any benefit to the convict which is generally given to other inmates of Jail as per the Jail manual on good conduct of the convict and further, the convict would die in jail.
4. In this writ petition, petitioner has challenged the said observation made in the judgment dated 16.10.2018 passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO), Almora.
5. Learned State Counsel points out that the petitioner has challenged his conviction by filing an appeal under Section 374 of Cr.P.C., which is registered as Criminal Appeal No.355 of 2018.

Thus,
he submits that a writ petition challenging observation made in judgment rendered by learned Special Judge (POCSO), Almora will not be maintainable.
6. We find substance in the said submission.

Since, petitioner has challenged his conviction and sentence under Section 374 of Cr.P.C. by filing an appeal, therefore, he cannot challenge the observation made in the said judgment in independent proceedings under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.

1 7. Accordingly, writ petition fails and is dismissed, with liberty to the petitioner to move appropriate application in his pending appeal.
